subject: Re: PoC / Deployment mode follow-up — Hartwell AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hartwell <alex@hartwell.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-15T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: PoC follow-up + deployment mode options

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and proposed next steps for the PoC:

Summary of needs:
- Data residency + VPC requirement for PII inference (HIPAA-adjacent)
- Sustained throughput target ~50 reqs/sec with 200-token avg responses
- Prediction latency target <= 300ms p50 for production

Deployment modes we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to start, lower ops overhead, may not meet VPC/data residency reqs
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pool, predictable throughput, can isolate customer data
- Private (VPC/on-prem): required if Hartwell needs full network isolation and KMS-managed keys

Proposed PoC approach:
1) Start with a 2-week trial on Dedicated to validate throughput/latency and cost profile
2) Parallel security review for Private deployment if your legal/security team requires it (we can share SOC2 evidence and network design)
3) Success criteria: 50 reqs/sec sustained for 1 hour, p50 latency <300ms, qualitative parity on NLL/response quality vs your baseline test set

Deliverables / timeline:
- This week: share PoC plan + success criteria (attached) — owner: me
- Next week: infra kickoff with Marissa (solutions) and your infra lead (Samir) — schedule 60m
- Week 3–4: run PoC on Dedicated capacity, monitor metrics and iterate prompts

Can you confirm stakeholders (legal/security, infra, ML) and whether we should start on Dedicated vs. jump straight to a Private onboarding?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0137

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-hartwell-v1.pdf (PoC plan summary)

From: Alex Hartwell <alex@hartwell.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@hartwell.ai>
Date: 2027-02-16T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC follow-up + deployment mode options

Thanks Ben — good write-up. A few clarifications from our side:

- Stakeholders: Samir (infra) and Priya Shah (security/legal, priya.shah@hartwell.ai). I’ll loop Priya if we move forward with Private.
- Preferred start: we would like to validate Dedicated first to confirm performance and cost. If Dedicated meets security checklist (with VPC peering and customer-managed KMS), we may not need a full on-prem.
- Timeline: Samir can do an infra kickoff next Wed (2027-02-24) and can commit 2 full days for setup.

Success criteria look good. One ask: can you include an explicit checklist for the SOC2 evidence and network diagrams for the Private path so Priya can triage quickly?

Alex
Head of Product | Hartwell AI
alex@hartwell.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hartwell <alex@hartwell.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-17T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC follow-up + deployment mode options

Hi Alex / Samir — looping myself and Jordan for infra implementation and pricing notes. I’m Marissa (solutions engineer) — I’ll own the infra kickoff and checklist.

What I’ll bring to the kickoff:
- Dedicated trial environment template (network, IAM, KMS config)
- Performance test harness and default prompt set to reproduce your 200-token average load
- SOC2 artifacts and architecture diagram for Private flow (to share with Priya)

Pre-kickoff asks for Samir:
- Do you have a staging VPC we can peer to? If not, we can run in a temporary VPC and provide an ingress NAT for test traffic.
- Confirm an ML test corpus (ideally a subset of 500 examples) we can use for quality and latency tests.

I’ll attach the deployment-mode comparison and a proposed 4-week PoC timeline. Ben — can you drop the DocuSign SOW for the Dedicated trial once Alex confirms? Jordan — FYI on pricing/commits: Hartwell is likely to need a 2-week reserved trial, then scale to 1–3 month reserved window depending on results.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: deployment-mode-comparison-sheet.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@hartwell.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PoC follow-up + deployment mode options

Alex — thanks for confirming. Per your ask I’ve attached the finalized PoC plan and SOC2 checklist; Marissa will run the kickoff next Wed (2027-02-24) at 10am PT — Samir, does that still work?

Next steps (action owners):
- Ben: send DocuSign SOW for 2-week Dedicated trial + payment info (sent) — link: https://docusign.com/s/ABC123 (placeholder)
- Marissa: infra kickoff, perf harness, SOC2 artifacts (attached)
- Samir: confirm staging VPC & share sample corpus (action: share by 2027-02-22)
- Priya: triage SOC2/network diagram for Private path (optional)

Success criteria reiterated:
- 50 reqs/sec sustained for 1 hour on Dedicated
- p50 latency <300ms for 200-token avg
- Acceptable qualitative parity on model outputs (no >10% drop vs your baseline on key intents)

Let me know if any of the criteria need to be tightened. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
